problem_statement: B09aa proves no current repository source is authorized as ActionWindow horizon authority. A topology decision is required before any horizon contract or producer can be created.

rationale: ActionWindow is an Eligibility criterion, so its risk-tolerance horizon is product eligibility policy rather than execution scheduling
embedding horizon authority in the selected Eligibility policy avoids creating another parallel policy-selection authority
the existing B09v selector already establishes one exact policy_ref at Candidate decision_time
horizon provenance can therefore remain causally tied to the same selected policy identity
dynamic agronomic shortening may be added later as calculation under explicit policy bounds without changing ownership

contract_evolution_rule.recommended_successor: DecisionEligibilityPolicyDeclarationV2 or semantically equivalent successor contract
contract_evolution_rule.migration_rule: existing v1 declarations remain valid for v1 semantics and must not receive inferred/default ActionWindow horizons
contract_evolution_rule.action_window_requirement_rule: if a successor policy requires ACTION_WINDOW, it must carry explicit horizon authority content/ref; absence fails closed

horizon_provenance_rule.horizon_source_authority: same immutable successor Eligibility policy declaration/content

value_semantics.reason: B09ab chooses ownership/topology only; numerical/actionability value semantics remain a separate governance decision

dynamic_future_extension.mcft_dependency: Forecast-dependent dynamic shortening remains blocked until MCFT-9 COMPLETE plus separate integration authorization
